answer_2.quote: We employed Word Error Rate (WER) for English and Character Error Rate (CER) for Chinese, along with NISQA-V2, as objective metrics to evaluate the quality of single‑speaker speech synthesis.

answer_4.quote: we relied on 5‑scale Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) with 95% confidence intervals as our subjective metric. ... a total of 12 participants were asked to provide ratings for the synthesized speech.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each synthesized speech sample on a 5‑point MOS scale for overall quality.
